events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now. A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game.

events.name: Bolo Mules - Playin' 90's Country Hits
events.info: The Bolo Mules are the greatest 90?s Country band that never was. The origin story of this ten-piece juggernaut of a band is as hazy as the bars and dancehalls that made them. What is a Bolo Mule? Who the hell is Stacy Stillwater? How many husbands has Kitty Miller had? Did Roscoe Skinner steal my cigarettes? The answers may be unclear, but the fact remains that the Bolo Mules are a veritable wrecking crew of musicians and performers who have captivated fans across the country with each and every show they?ve performed. Born in Kentucky, but now running wild, the band?s live show is a fever dream with WWE-level theatrics and all the musicality of Aunt Patty?s 90?s Country favorites . Their unrelenting live show and downright captivating personas have garnered the attention of a loyal and enthusiastic fan base that may be just as crazy as the band members themselves. A Bolo Mule is as a Bolo Mule does, and for now, that means playing 90?s Country hits the only way they know how.

events.name: Chad Prather
events.info: Chad Prather is an American commentator, comedian, speaker, and entrepreneur known for blending humor, cultural commentary, and faith-driven conviction into a multi platform media presence. With a background in stand up comedy and viral social media videos, he built an international following by delivering sharp, common sense takes on faith, politics, culture, and personal responsibility. Called a , "rdquo" -> modern-day Will Rogers," he is the host of the daily podcasts Before the Noise and The Chad Prather Show, reaching millions of viewers/listeners with a mix of biblical teaching, cultural analysis, and motivational commentary. He challenges audiences to think critically, live intentionally, and anchor their lives in truth before reacting to the chaos of the world. In 2022, Prather ran for Governor of Texas, bringing his message of constitutional principles, limited government, and individual liberty into the political arena. While his campaign energized grassroots supporters across the state, he continues to focus primarily on media, live events, and entrepreneurial ventures. Prather is a touring live performer, delivering sold out comedy and speaking events across the country. He is also the founder of multiple business ventures and merchandise brands tied to his growing creative ecosystem. Whether on stage, behind a microphone, or in front of a camera, Chad Prather uses humor to challenge his audiences to stand firm in their beliefs and live with purpose. He has four adult children and calls both Texas and Tennessee home.
